intent: Default USER-FACING release for all vocabulary/lexical production workstreams is ONE COMPLETE, ORGANIZED CONTENT-PRODUCTION ZIP, not a one-TSV simplified ZIP and not a Flashcards app/runtime release.
decision_authority: User explicit clarification (2026-10-08): preserve all relevant vocabulary-production files for later updates and debugging; exclude Flashcards Pro application from uploaded ZIP. Previous one-file simplification was an incorrect interpretation.

supersedes.note: These prior content-file exclusions are REVOKED for vocabulary production. Historical minimalist L01 ZIPs remain immutable artifacts but are NOT the default or a complete-workstream resume authority.

included: NVV and other lexical-card workstreams when they generate vocabulary outputs
excluded: standalone Grammar/Lesen/Schreiben nonlexical deliverables unless their own policy explicitly opts in
scope.default_trigger: When delivering/uploading/completing a vocabulary, lexical card, word, lesson, or vocabulary workstream output
scope.user_override: Explicit scoped request for a single-file import, app release, alternate archive layout, or separate artifacts overrides this default only for the specified delivery.

default_layout.01-Final-Import: Final exact import-ready TSV/JSON and required content-only import envelope files; preserve exact verified output bytes and schema.
default_layout.02-Canonical-Data: Canonical lexical inventory, stable IDs, multi-sense representations, normalized tables/relations, accepted working data needed to regenerate output.
default_layout.03-Source-Provenance: Registered original inputs/snapshots and source-to-card maps/locators, manifests, hashes, audio reference metadata; raw copyrighted/large material only when permitted.
default_layout.04-Enrichment-Work: Accepted lexical combinations, sense/structure/grammar enrichment, reviewed evidence, disposition and rejected-candidate ledgers, active prompts/policy fingerprints relevant to this workstream.
default_layout.05-QA-Tests: Independent validation, source-fidelity/semantic/presentation audits, test fixtures and runnable content-only verification tools/scripts, negative tests as applicable.
default_layout.06-Reports: Quality reports, validation results, exceptions and boundary notes, import/runtime acceptance evidence where actually executed.
default_layout.07-Checkpoint-State: Portable state/checkpoint, explicit stage and next step, dependency and lineage fingerprints, artifacts/manifests/sha256; latest valid authority identity.
default_layout.08-Docs: Workstream-specific README, import/update/merge instructions, maintainers' handoff and repeatability notes.

no_generated_garbage: duplicate obsolete outputs unless historical lineage is explicitly needed
default_delivery.nested_zip_rule: Avoid nested ZIP duplicates. If exact import format itself requires a separate ZIP, include that required content-only import ZIP under 01-Final-Import and document why; never embed app ZIP.
default_delivery.source_rights_rule: Include the accessible source evidence needed for reuse where lawful and practical. If raw licensed files/audio cannot be redistributed or are too large, include source identity, exact hashes, locators, extraction/provenance manifest and retrieval instructions, mark external dependency in checkpoint and NEVER claim the ZIP is fully standalone for raw-source reconstruction.
default_delivery.fidelity_rule: Preserve IDs, ordering, source/audio memberships, canonical semantics, source claims, schema and content hashes; packaging must never silently regenerate/change approved cards.
default_delivery.no_fabrication: Do not fill missing source/QA evidence or fake Stage6/browser/runtime PASS in order to satisfy a packaging gate.

required: Inspect FINAL ZIP itself and verify CRC/path safety/manifest SHA256
Verify content is importable in documented format; content-only validator PASS
Verify expected workstream source/canonical/enrichment/QA/checkpoint/docs/tools/evidence are included OR explicitly listed as externally-held with reason
Verify no Flashcards app/runtime bits are bundled
Verify retained import output SHA256 identical to upstream accepted content and no unwanted source/identity changes
Record app CURRENT and Stage6 status separately if runtime compatibility matters
Re-extract ZIP into a fresh directory and run applicable tests before PASS
Store one verified complete production ZIP to Library/Project and compact hash + checkpoint to Git
validation.do_not_claim: A complete content-production ZIP is NOT automatic live browser import/SRS/production app approval.

artifact_separation.user_receives: One complete production/content ZIP (all necessary workstream files, NOT just final TSV)
artifact_separation.git: Small text contract/metadata/checkpoints only; no binary ZIP reconstruction
artifact_separation.app_release: The Flashcards-Pro whole-app release remains a distinct delivery contract, unchanged
artifact_separation.specialized_import_only: If explicitly requested, a small import-only ZIP/TSV may additionally or instead be produced, but it must never silently replace the complete vocabulary-production handoff.

compatibility.framework: v3.3.6 Stage1-Stage7 content quality and exact CURRENT runtime acceptance gates remain unchanged
compatibility.previous_l01_example: Menschen-A1-L01-v3.3.6-CONTENT-ONLY-SOURCE-AUDITED.zip was a prior content-only organized archive; FINAL-OUTPUT-ONLY.zip was a simplified variant and must not become the template for future complete production releases.
compatibility.historical_artifact_rule: Do not overwrite/delete already-locked outputs; apply to next vocabulary delivery or explicit repackage request.
